exposure: Placenta accreta diagnosis method (ultrasound, MRI, direct vision)
Comparison of two cohorts over time (2003-2010 vs. 2009-2016)
cohort: 61 patients who underwent nonemergent hysterectomy for placenta accreta at Tampa General Hospital from June 1, 2003, to May 31, 2016
finding: Nonemergent hysterectomy for placenta accreta remains associated with significant morbidity in the forms of hemorrhage and urinary tract insult.
